category_title: Six-year-old girl with PDD-NOS exhibiting behavioral obsessions and communication delays
minimal_context: The student and teacher are sitting at a desk for a teaching activity using course materials.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for our teaching activity. Let's look at these course materials on the desk.

STUDENT: (Sits sideways in her chair, holding the 'Lemon Girl' book in her hands and not focusing on the teaching activity.)

TUTOR: Look at the materials. Point to the correct answer.

STUDENT: (Faces away from the teacher and the materials, getting up and sitting down at her desk without responding.)

TUTOR: Please point to the answer on the desk.

STUDENT: (Throws the course materials, gets up from the desk, and does not respond to the discriminative stimulus.)

options.A: Ask the student to point to the answer, prompting: 'This one, you know it.'
options.B: Point to an additional course material, sliding a finger out from the corner of the desk.
options.C: Draw on the course materials, label the items, and provide explicit explanations of the activity.
options.D: Secure the student's attention before giving the discriminative stimulus during the teaching activity.
